decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 21 December 2006, an erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window including a small extension on to the roof of the rear extension and insertion of a roof light on the front roof slope to the house, has the volume of 37.04m3 which would give a total volume increase to the original house of 38.87m3, as shown on drawing number 1166/3C - Sheets 1 to 5, received 21 December 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window including a small extension on to the roof of the rear extension and insertion of a roof light on the front roof slope to the house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informatives: 

1. The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - 2. The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window including a small extension on to the roof of the rear extension and insertion of a roof light on the front roof slope of house
